messages:
Aria Gomez: Hi everyone, Aria here (data infra)  just started. Two quick security onboarding questions: 1) I received the phishing simulation notice but my MacBook is delayed. Can I opt out until I get the company device? 2) Is it ok to use a personal Mac with minimal Jamf profile, or should I request a loaner? Also, how do I check FileVault status?

Liam (People Ops): welcome Aria! :wave: You can request a loaner and well mark you as exempt until you have a managed device. If you prefer to enroll your personal Mac, we push a minimal policy for new hires. Security Basics is required within 72 hours for channel access.

Tao IT: @Aria - to check FileVault open Terminal and run `fdesetup status`. If it says "FileVault is Off" please enable in System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault. The minimal Jamf profile enforces disk encryption, screen lock, and basic password policy only. No mail or SSO certs are installed.

Aria Gomez: ran `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off". Im happy to enable but worried about Jamf touching my Docker images. Does enrollment affect local containers?

Tao IT: Jamf does not touch user files or Docker images. The minimal contractor/new-hire policy only sets system prefs and an MDM check-in. If youd rather avoid any MDM footprint well prioritize a loaner for you.

Rina InfoSec: MFA is independent of device so set that up ASAP. For phishing sims: if youre on a loaner youll be included; personal devices remain exempt unless enrolled. If you need a faster loaner turnaround, reply "loaner-request" here and Facilities will follow up.

PhishSimBot: User Aria Gomez added to upcoming phishing cohort on 2026-10-05. Reply with "loaner-request" to request exemption until managed device assignment.

Aria Gomez: loaner-request. Also: any recommended steps to confirm FileVault enabled correctly?

Tao IT: After enabling, run `fdesetup status` again; it should show "FileVault is On" and list the enabled user(s). We can also verify Jamf check-in once enrolled. If you hit an error with `sudo fdesetup enable`, paste the output here and well help.

Facilities: Loaner request received for Aria Gomez. Please complete the loaner form (https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form) and choose delivery or pickup. We can include charger + privacy screen. Estimated delivery 2 business days after approval.

Liam (People Ops): Marked Aria as exempt for the phishing cohort and added to the onboarding tracker. Welcome to the team! :tada:
